exclusions.source_text: Creatinine clearance (CrCl) ≥ 50 mL/min using the Cockcroft-Gault formula (Cohorts 1 and 2) or estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) value ≥ 60 mL/min (for Cohort 1) or ≥30 mL/min (for Cohort 2) using the Cockcroft-Gault formula or estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR)
Serum total bilirubin (TBIL) ≤ 1.5 × upper limit of normal (ULN); for patients with liver metastases or confirmed/suspected Gilbert syndrome, TBIL ≤3 × ULN
exclusions.threshold: TBIL ≤ 1.5 × ULN (≤3 × ULN with liver metastases or Gilbert)

exclusions.source_text:
Aspartate aminotransferase (AST) and alanine aminotransferase (ALT)
  * 2.5 × ULN; for patients with liver metastases, AST and ALT ≤ 5 × ULN
exclusions.threshold: AST/ALT ≤ 2.5 × ULN (≤ 5 × ULN with liver metastases)

exclusions.source_text: Female patients of childbearing age must have negative serum pregnancy test results
Clinically asymptomatic treated or untreated brain metastases are allowed if they have not required increasing doses of steroids within 2 weeks prior to study entry for CNS symptoms.
Participants previously treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors or other T cell immune-modulating antibodies
Unstable angina, myocardial infarction, congestive heart failure (New York Heart Association \[NYHA\] classification ≥ grade 2) or unstable vascular disease
Known history of human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) whose viral load is not controlled.

Symptomatic CNS metastases, CNS metastases with hemorrhagic features, CNS metastasis ≥ 1.5 cm, CNS radiation within 7 days prior to first ivonescimab dose, potential need for CNS radiation within the first cycle, or leptomeningeal disease.
Patient is breastfeeding or plans to breastfeed during the study
Active or prior history of inflammatory bowel disease (eg, Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, or chronic diarrhea)
